- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.

| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| today | today's date as YYYY-MM-DD | — |
| now | the current UTC time (ISO 8601) | — |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Sync incomplete: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. CALL `get_project_execution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   Make this call once per sync (it is heavy). This playbook only reads: make no write, even for a problem it finds.
   SAVE: open = result.planning.openIssues (at most 50, not done or canceled); capped = "yes" if it has 50 items, else "no"; cycles = result.planning.activeCycles; milestones = result.planning.openMilestones; decisions = the items of result.governance (the owner's decisions: list them, never decide them)
2. CALL `list_blocked_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → go to step 3.
   SAVE: blocked = the id of every item; go to step 4.
3. CALL `get_project_dependency_summary` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: blocked = the issueId of every item of result.criticalBlockers
4. CALL `recommend_next_activity` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: next = "<result.recommendation.issueId> (<result.recommendation.strategy>)", plus " in project <result.recommendation.projectId>" when that differs from <input:projectId>; "no actionable activity" when result.recommendation is null
5. SAVE: inProgress = the items of <saved:open> with status "in-progress"
   SAVE: stale = the items of <saved:open> with status "in-progress" whose updatedAt is more than 48 hours before <input:now> (comments not checked)
   SAVE: overdue = the items of <saved:open> whose dueDate is a YYYY-MM-DD date before <input:today> (an unparsable dueDate is never overdue)
   SAVE: load = the assigneeId holding more than 40 % of the items of <saved:open> with status "todo" or "in-progress" (empty if none)
   SAVE: staleCycles = the items of <saved:cycles> whose endDate is before <input:today>; twoActive = "yes" if <saved:cycles> has 2 or more items, else "no"
   SAVE: risky = "yes" if one cycleId holds 3 or more activities that are in <saved:stale>, <saved:overdue> or <saved:blocked>, else "no"
   SAVE: line = "in-progress <count of inProgress> · stale <count> (<ids>) · blocked <count> (<ids>) · overdue <count> (<ids>) · next <saved:next>"

     title: starts with a verb, in the user's language, then the user's words. A bug ("erro", "errado", "bug", "falha") → "Corrigir …"; a feature → "Implementar …"; a screen → "Exibir …". Already a verb → keep it. Example: "cálculo de juros do parcelamento" → "Implementar cálculo de juros do parcelamento".
     description: one sentence on what will be done, a blank line, "Critérios de aceite:" (in the user's language), then one "- <criterion>" line per criterion from the user's words, else the result the title promises.
     priority: "urgent", "high", "medium", "low" from the user's words (urgente, alta, média, baixa); no word → "none".
   Never add status, assigneeId, estimate, dueDate, cycleId, milestoneId or labelIds: owners and dates need approval (playbook owners-dates), moves use playbook edit-activities, after creation.
   SAVE: later = the rows after the 25th (empty if 25 or fewer); plan = the first 25 rows

4. SAVE: dupes = the rows of <saved:plan> whose title, or whose words as the user wrote them, lowercased and trimmed, equal an entry of <saved:titles> (exact match only; a similar title is not a duplicate)
   IF <saved:dupes> is not empty → ASK: "These titles already exist in <input:projectId>: <saved:dupes>. Create them again anyway? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was created. Send the list without the duplicates."
   SAVE: n = 1 + the number of batch keys you already sent for <input:projectId> in this conversation; key = "plan-<input:projectId>-<input:day>-<saved:n>"
   SAVE: title, description, priority = per row of <saved:plan>: its title, description and priority (one operations item per row)
5. CALL `batch_issue_operations` {"idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>","stopOnError":true,"operations":[{"tool":"create_issue","arguments":{"projectId":"<input:projectId>","title":"<saved:title>","description":"<saved:description>","priority":"<saved:priority>"}}]} [A] (one operations item per row of <saved:plan>, in order)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "batch_issue_operations failed: <error text>. Run me again: step 2 re-reads the titles, so nothing is created twice."
   SAVE: created = for each item with status "succeeded": the id after "ID: " in its result, with its row's title and priority; failed = for each item with status "failed" or "skipped": its row's title and its error message

   SAVE: firstId = the first id of <saved:created>

   IF the call returns an error or result.title is not the title of that row → STOP. Say: "<saved:firstId> does not read back as created: <error text or its title>."
6. FOR EACH item IN <saved:created> (none → go to step 7):

   IF the call returns an error or result.title != <each:title> → STOP. Say: "<each:id> does not read back as created: <error text or its title>."
7. SAVE: status = the status of the last get_issue result; pending = one "<title> — <error>" line per entry of <saved:failed>, plus "<title> — not sent (more than 25)" per row of <saved:later>

## § flow-owners-dates

## Playbook: owners-dates
Use when: set owners, estimates or due dates; work a queue

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| queue | "unassigned", "unestimated" or "overdue" when the user named that queue ("sem responsável", "sem estimativa", "atrasadas") | "none" |
| issueIds | the activity ids the user named | "none" |
| person | the owner's name or email as the user wrote it | "none" (no owner change) |
| estimate | hours as a number ("8h" → 8) | "none" |
| dueDate | the date as YYYY-MM-DD ("31/10" → "<this year>-10-31") | "none" |
| day | today's date as yyyymmdd | — |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF <input:person>, <input:estimate> and <input:dueDate> are all "none" → STOP. Say: "Which owner, estimate or due date should I set?"
   IF result.credential == "oauth" and <input:person> != "none" → STOP. Say: "Assigning owners needs an LPM API key: connectors cannot list the eligible members."
   IF result.credential == "oauth" and <input:queue> != "none" → STOP. Say: "The unassigned, unestimated and overdue queues need an LPM API key. Name the activities instead."
   SAVE: targets = <input:issueIds> (empty if "none"); rows = empty; uid = "none"; owner = "none"; queueCount = "n/a"
   IF <input:queue> == "none" → go to step 5.
   IF <input:queue> == "unestimated" → go to step 3.
   IF <input:queue> == "overdue" → go to step 4.
2. CALL `list_unassigned_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: targets = the id of the first 25 items; queueCount = result.count; go to step 5.
3. CALL `list_unestimated_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: targets = the id of the first 25 items; queueCount = result.count; go to step 5.
4. CALL `list_overdue_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "The overdue queue is denied (<error text>): it needs a project governance role. Name the activities, or ask for the daily sync."
   SAVE: targets = the id of the first 25 items; queueCount = result.count
5. IF <input:person> == "none" → go to step 7.
6. CALL `list_project_assignable_members` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: matches = the items whose displayName or email contains <input:person>, ignoring case
   IF <saved:matches> is empty or has 2 or more items → STOP. Say: "Which person: <each match as "<displayName> (<email>)">?"
   Show only displayName and email: never hourlyRate, currency or directoryOrigins. Never pick one yourself; never use a workspace or team member id.
   SAVE: uid = the uid of the one match; owner = its displayName (else its email)
7. FOR EACH target IN <saved:targets> (none → go to step 8):
   CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<each:id>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<each:id> could not be read: <error text>. Nothing was changed."
   SAVE: rows = <saved:rows> plus "<each:id> '<result.title>'" and, for each field you set, "owner <result.assigneeId or none> → <saved:owner>", "estimate <result.estimate or none> → <input:estimate>", "due <result.dueDate or none> → <input:dueDate>"
8. IF <saved:rows> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which activities? Name their ids, or a queue: unassigned, unestimated or overdue."
   SAVE: n = 1 + the number of batch keys you already sent for <input:projectId> in this conversation; key = "plan-<input:projectId>-<input:day>-<saved:n>"
   SAVE: issueId = per entry of <saved:targets>, its id (one operations item per target)
9. ASK: "Apply this plan? <each line of <saved:rows>> (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was changed."
   This one "yes" covers owner, estimate and due date together.
10. CALL `batch_issue_operations` {"idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>","stopOnError":false,"operations":[{"tool":"update_issue","arguments":{"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:issueId>","assigneeId":"<saved:uid>","estimate":"<input:estimate>","dueDate":"<input:dueDate>"}}]} [A] (one operations item per target; keep only the fields you set; estimate as a number, without quotes; never null)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "batch_issue_operations failed: <error text>. Run me again: I re-read every activity before writing."
   SAVE: failed = for each item with status "failed" or "skipped": the issueId of its operation and its error message; firstOk = the issueId of the first item with status "succeeded"
   IF <saved:firstOk> is empty → go to step 11.
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:firstOk>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or a field you set does not equal the plan → STOP. Say: "<saved:firstOk> does not show the new values: <error text or its values>."
11. FOR EACH target IN <saved:targets> (none → go to step 12):
   CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<each:id>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error and <each:id> is not in <saved:failed> → STOP. Say: "<each:id> could not be read back: <error text>."
   IF the call succeeds, <each:id> is not in <saved:failed>, and a field you set does not equal the plan → STOP. Say: "<each:id> does not show the new values."
   A failed id that get_issue cannot find ("Issue not found") was deleted after the queue read: never retry or recreate it.
12. SAVE: changed = the rows of <saved:rows> whose id is not in <saved:failed>; pending = one "<issueId> — <error>" line per entry of <saved:failed>

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: project <input:projectId>, <queue <input:queue> (<saved:queueCount> in queue) | the named activities>
Done: <each line of <saved:changed> | nothing changed>
Evidence: batch <saved:key>: planned <entries of <saved:targets>>, updated <entries of <saved:changed>>, failed <entries of <saved:failed>>; read back with get_issue | none
Pending: <none | <saved:pending> — the user decides (I never recreate a deleted activity)>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | resend only the failed ids (I build a new key) | confirm the dates with <saved:owner> | none>
```
Pending is never "none" while <saved:failed> has an entry. Never claim a value changed unless a get_issue above read it.

   SAVE: before = <saved:before> plus "<each:issueId>: <each planned field> <its value in result, or none>"; oldLabels = <saved:oldLabels> plus "<each:issueId>: result.labelIds"
4. SAVE: n = 1 + the number of batch keys you already sent for <input:projectId> in this conversation; key = "edit-<input:projectId>-<input:day>-<saved:n>"; firstId = the issueId of the first row

## § flow-cancel-or-delete

## Playbook: cancel-or-delete
Use when: cancel or delete an activity

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| issueId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which activity? (id or title)" |
| change | "cancel", or "delete" only when the user said delete ("apagar", "excluir", "delete") | "cancel" |
| named | "yes" when the user named this activity by id or exact title, "no" when you picked it | "no" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was canceled or deleted."
1. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: title, status, requirementId, baselineId = those fields of result (empty if absent); factory = "yes" if result.factoryGovernance is set, else "no"
   IF <saved:status> == "done" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-deliver-activity.md`. Say: "<input:issueId> is done; undoing a closure is not planning."
   IF <saved:status> == "canceled" and <input:change> == "cancel" → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> is already canceled."
2. IF <saved:requirementId> is empty → go to step 3.
   ASK: "<saved:title> delivers requirement <saved:requirementId>. Does that requirement stay in scope without it? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Removing it changes scope: that is a governance decision (skill lpm-governance-decisions). Nothing was changed."
3. IF <input:change> == "cancel" and <input:named> == "no" → ASK: "Cancel <saved:title> (<input:issueId>)? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
   IF <input:change> == "cancel" → go to step 6.
4. CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: commits = the items whose content starts with "Vinculação automática de" or contains "/commit/" (commits linked by LPM-Activity)
   SAVE: reasons = "AISH factory activity" if <saved:factory> == "yes"; "linked commits" if <saved:commits> is not empty; "bound to requirement <saved:requirementId>" or "bound to baseline <saved:baselineId>" when set (empty if none)
   IF <saved:reasons> is empty → go to step 7.
5. ASK: "<saved:title> has <saved:reasons>. Deleting it would break that history, so I will not delete it. Cancel it instead? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was deleted."
6. CALL `update_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","status":"canceled"} [A]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "canceled" → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> is <result.status>, not canceled."
   SAVE: status = result.status; outcome = "canceled (history kept)"; go to Answer.
7. ASK: "Delete <saved:title> (<input:issueId>)? There is no undo: its comments and links are destroyed. Cancel keeps the history. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was deleted."
8. CALL `delete_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not deleted: <error text>. Do not retry; deleting needs an LPM API key with profile full or custom."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or the issue, unless that error is "Issue not found" → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> still reads back (<error text or its status>); the delete is not confirmed."
   SAVE: status = "deleted"; outcome = "deleted"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: project <input:projectId>, activity <input:issueId> <saved:title>
Done: <<saved:outcome> | nothing changed>; status <saved:status>
Evidence: <get_issue re-read: status canceled | get_issue re-read: "Issue not found" | none>
Pending: <none | <saved:reasons> kept it from being deleted>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none>
```
status: backlog | todo | in-progress | done | canceled, from your last get_issue, or "deleted" when that get_issue said "Issue not found". Never claim a cancel or delete that its VERIFY did not show.


## § flow-cycle-open-or-start

## Playbook: cycle-open-or-start
Use when: open or start a cycle (sprint)

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| action | "open" to create a cycle, "start" to activate one | STOP. Say: "Open a new cycle, or start an existing one?" |
| cycle | for "start": the cycle name or id the user gave | "none" |
| name | for "open": the name the user gave ("Sprint 4 2026") | "none" (then "<startDate> to <endDate>") |
| startDate | for "open": the start date the user gave, as YYYY-MM-DD; never invent it | "none" |
| endDate | for "open": the end date the user gave, as YYYY-MM-DD; never invent it | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was changed."
1. CALL `list_cycles` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: cycles = every item's id, name, status, startDate and endDate (unsorted: sort by startDate yourself); active = the items with status "active"
   IF <input:action> == "start" → go to step 4.
2. IF <input:startDate> or <input:endDate> is "none" → STOP. Say: "Which start and end dates (YYYY-MM-DD)?"
   IF <input:endDate> is not after <input:startDate> → STOP. Say: "The end date must be after the start date."
   SAVE: overlap = the items of <saved:cycles> with status "upcoming" or "active" whose dates overlap <input:startDate> to <input:endDate>; cycleName = <input:name>, else "<input:startDate> to <input:endDate>"
   IF <saved:overlap> is not empty → ASK: "Cycle <each overlap as "<name> (<id>)"> already covers these dates. Create <saved:cycleName> anyway? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was created."
3. CALL `create_cycle` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","name":"<saved:cycleName>","startDate":"<input:startDate>","endDate":"<input:endDate>","status":"upcoming"} [A] (create once: it has no retry key)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "create_cycle failed: <error text>. Run me again: step 1 re-lists the cycles first."
   SAVE: cycleId = the id after "ID: " in result
   VERIFY: CALL `get_cycle` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","cycleId":"<saved:cycleId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.name, result.startDate, result.endDate or result.status ("upcoming") differ from what you sent → STOP. Say: "Cycle <saved:cycleId> does not read back as sent: <error text or its values>."
   SAVE: state = "<saved:cycleName> (<saved:cycleId>) <result.startDate> to <result.endDate>, upcoming"; go to Answer.
4. SAVE: cycleId, cycleName, cycleState = the id, name and status of the item of <saved:cycles> whose id or name equals <input:cycle>, ignoring case
   IF no item or 2 or more items match → STOP. Say: "Which cycle? <each cycle as "<name> (<id>, <status>)">"
   IF <saved:cycleState> == "active" → STOP. Say: "<saved:cycleName> is already active."
   IF <saved:cycleState> == "completed" → STOP. Say: "<saved:cycleName> is completed. Open a new cycle instead."
   IF <saved:active> is not empty → ASK: "<each active as "<name> (<id>)"> is still active. Start <saved:cycleName> too (two active cycles), or close the old one first with playbook cycle-close? (yes = start both)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
5. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","cycleId":"<saved:cycleId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: inCycle = the id of every item; partial = "yes" if result.hasMore == true, else "no"
6. CALL `get_project_dependency_summary` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: outside = "dependency check failed: <error text>"; go to step 7.
   SAVE: outside = for each item of result.criticalBlockers whose issueId is in <saved:inCycle>: each of its blockers whose issueId is not in <saved:inCycle>, as "<issueId> blocked by <blocker issueId> (<blocker status>)" (empty if none)
   IF <saved:outside> is empty → go to step 8.
7. ASK: "<saved:outside>. These blockers are outside <saved:cycleName>. Start it anyway? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was changed."
8. CALL `update_cycle` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","cycleId":"<saved:cycleId>","status":"active"} [A]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_cycle` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","cycleId":"<saved:cycleId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "active" → STOP. Say: "<saved:cycleName> is <result.status>, not active."
   SAVE: state = "<saved:cycleName> (<saved:cycleId>) upcoming → active"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: project <input:projectId>, cycle <saved:cycleName>
Done: <cycle <saved:state> | nothing changed>
Evidence: <get_cycle read the cycle back | none>; outside blockers: <<saved:outside> | none | not checked>
Pending: <none | only the first 100 activities of the cycle were checked (when <saved:partial> is "yes")>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | add activities with playbook edit-activities (field cycleId) | none>
```
Cycle states are upcoming | active | completed ("planned" does not exist), from your last get_cycle. Never claim a cycle state that a get_cycle above did not read.


## § flow-cycle-close

## Playbook: cycle-close
Use when: close or delete a cycle

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| cycle | the cycle name or id the user gave | STOP. Say: "Which cycle? (name or id)" |
| action | "close", or "delete" only when the user said delete ("apagar", "excluir") | "close" |
| moveTo | for open activities: a cycle name or id, "next" (the next upcoming cycle), or "leave" | "ask" |
| day | today's date as yyyymmdd | — |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. The cycle was not changed."
1. CALL `list_cycles` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: cycleId, cycleName, cycleState, startDate = the id, name, status and startDate of the item whose id or name equals <input:cycle>, ignoring case
   IF no item or 2 or more items match → STOP. Say: "Which cycle? <each cycle as "<name> (<id>, <status>)">"
   IF <saved:cycleState> == "completed" and <input:action> == "close" → STOP. Say: "<saved:cycleName> is already completed."
   SAVE: nextId, nextName = the id and name of the item whose id or name equals <input:moveTo>; for "next": the "upcoming" item with the earliest startDate after <saved:startDate> (empty if none)
2. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","cycleId":"<saved:cycleId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF result.hasMore == true → STOP. Say: "<saved:cycleName> has more than 100 activities; I list at most 100. Use the LPM web UI."
   SAVE: holds = the id of every item; open = the id and title of every item whose status is neither "done" nor "canceled"; moved = empty; failed = empty
   Closing a cycle does not move or close its activities.
3. IF <input:action> == "delete" → go to step 7.
   IF <saved:open> is empty or <input:moveTo> == "leave" → go to step 6.
   IF <input:moveTo> == "ask" → STOP. Say: "<saved:cycleName> has <count of open> open activities (<each id>). Move them to the next cycle (name it), or leave them in <saved:cycleName>?"
   IF <saved:nextId> is empty → STOP. Say: "Cycle <input:moveTo> was not found. Open it with playbook cycle-open-or-start, then run me again."
   IF <saved:open> has more than 25 items → STOP. Say: "<count of open> open activities; I move at most 25 per run. Move some with playbook edit-activities first."
4. SAVE: n = 1 + the number of batch keys you already sent for <input:projectId> in this conversation; key = "move-<saved:cycleId>-<input:day>-<saved:n>"
   SAVE: issueId = per entry of <saved:open>, its id (one operations item per entry)
5. CALL `batch_issue_operations` {"idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>","stopOnError":false,"operations":[{"tool":"update_issue","arguments":{"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:issueId>","cycleId":"<saved:nextId>"}}]} [A] (one operations item per entry of <saved:open>)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "batch_issue_operations failed: <error text>. Run me again: step 2 re-reads the open activities."
   SAVE: failed = for each item with status "failed" or "skipped": the issueId of its operation and its error message
   VERIFY: CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","cycleId":"<saved:nextId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an id of <saved:open> that is not in <saved:failed> is missing from result.items → STOP. Say: "Not every activity shows cycle <saved:nextName>: <error text or the missing ids>. <saved:cycleName> was not closed."
   SAVE: moved = the ids of <saved:open> that result.items holds
   IF <saved:failed> is not empty → STOP. Say: "<each failed as "<issueId> — <error>">: not moved, so <saved:cycleName> stays open. Fix them, then run me again."
6. CALL `update_cycle` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","cycleId":"<saved:cycleId>","status":"completed"} [A]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_cycle` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","cycleId":"<saved:cycleId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "completed" → STOP. Say: "<saved:cycleName> is <result.status>, not completed."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:cycleName> <saved:cycleState> → <result.status>"; go to Answer.
7. ASK: "Delete cycle <saved:cycleName> (<saved:cycleId>)? No undo; <count of holds> activities keep pointing to it (<saved:holds>). Closing it (completed) keeps the history. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was deleted."
8. CALL `delete_cycle` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","cycleId":"<saved:cycleId>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not deleted: <error text>. Deleting needs an LPM API key with profile full or custom."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_cycles` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item has id == <saved:cycleId> → STOP. Say: "Cycle <saved:cycleId> is still listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:cycleName> deleted"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: project <input:projectId>, cycle <saved:cycleName> (<saved:cycleId>)
Done: <<saved:outcome> | nothing changed>; moved to <saved:nextName>: <each id of <saved:moved> | none>
Evidence: <get_cycle or list_cycles re-read; list_issues of <saved:nextName> showed the moved ids | none>
Pending: <none | left open in <saved:cycleName>: <each of <saved:open> as "<id> '<title>'"> | activities pointing to the deleted cycle: <saved:holds>>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | open the next cycle with playbook cycle-open-or-start | none>
```
Cycle states: upcoming | active | completed, from your last get_cycle. Never claim a cycle was completed or deleted, or an activity moved, unless a VERIFY above read it.


## § flow-milestone

## Playbook: milestone
Use when: open, close, re-date or delete a milestone

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| action | "open", "close", "date" (new target date), or "delete" (only if the user said delete) | STOP. Say: "Open, close, move the date of, or delete a milestone?" |
| milestone | for close, date, delete: the name or id the user gave | "none" |
| name | for open: the outcome it marks ("Pix em produção"), never a cycle name | "none" |
| targetDate | for open and date: the user's date as YYYY-MM-DD; never invent it | "none" |
| notify | for date: the person to notify, as the user named them | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was changed."
1. CALL `list_milestones` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: milestones = every item's id, name, status and targetDate
   IF <input:action> != "open" → go to step 3.
   IF <input:name> or <input:targetDate> is "none" → STOP. Say: "Which outcome does it mark, and which target date (YYYY-MM-DD)?"
   IF an item has the name <input:name>, ignoring case → STOP. Say: "Milestone <input:name> already exists (<its id>, <its status>)."
2. CALL `create_milestone` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","name":"<input:name>","targetDate":"<input:targetDate>"} [A] (create once: no retry key)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "create_milestone failed: <error text>. Run me again: step 1 sees it if it exists."
   SAVE: milestoneId = the id after "ID: " in result; mname = <input:name>
   VERIFY: CALL `get_milestone` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","milestoneId":"<saved:milestoneId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or its name, targetDate or status ("open") differ from what you sent → STOP. Say: "Milestone <saved:milestoneId> does not read back as sent."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:mname> (<saved:milestoneId>) open, target <result.targetDate>"; go to Answer.
3. SAVE: milestoneId, mname, mstate, oldDate = the id, name, status and targetDate of the item of <saved:milestones> whose id or name equals <input:milestone>, ignoring case
   IF no item or 2 or more items match → STOP. Say: "Which milestone? <each milestone as "<name> (<id>, <status>)">"
   IF <input:action> == "date" and <input:targetDate> is "none" → STOP. Say: "Which new target date (YYYY-MM-DD)?"
   IF <input:action> == "date" → go to step 6.
4. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","milestoneId":"<saved:milestoneId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: holds = the id of every item; open = the id and title of every item whose status is neither "done" nor "canceled"
   IF <input:action> == "delete" → go to step 11.
   IF <saved:mstate> == "closed" → STOP. Say: "<saved:mname> is already closed."
   Closing moves or closes no activity.
5. CALL `update_milestone` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","milestoneId":"<saved:milestoneId>","status":"closed"} [A]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_milestone` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","milestoneId":"<saved:milestoneId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "closed" → STOP. Say: "<saved:mname> is <result.status>, not closed."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:mname> open → closed"; go to Answer.
6. ASK: "Move milestone <saved:mname> from <saved:oldDate> to <input:targetDate>? It is a delivery commitment. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "The date was not changed."
7. CALL `update_milestone` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","milestoneId":"<saved:milestoneId>","targetDate":"<input:targetDate>"} [A]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_milestone` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","milestoneId":"<saved:milestoneId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.targetDate != <input:targetDate> → STOP. Say: "<saved:mname> shows target <result.targetDate>, not <input:targetDate>."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:mname> target <saved:oldDate> → <result.targetDate>"
   IF <input:notify> is "none" → go to Answer.
8. CALL `list_project_assignable_members` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: matches = the items whose displayName or email contains <input:notify>, ignoring case
   IF <saved:matches> is empty or has 2 or more items → STOP. Say: "Which person: <each match as "<displayName> (<email>)">?"
   Show only displayName and email (never hourlyRate); never pick one yourself.
   SAVE: uid = the uid of the one match; person = its displayName (else its email); message = "<saved:mname>: target date <saved:oldDate> → <input:targetDate>." in the user's language
9. ASK: "Notify <saved:person> (<saved:uid>): "<saved:message>", type due-date? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "No notification was sent."
10. CALL `create_notification` {"userId":"<saved:uid>","title":"<saved:mname>","message":"<saved:message>","type":"due-date"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Notice not sent: <error text>. I do not retry it."
   SAVE: notificationId = the id after "ID: " in result
   VERIFY: CALL `get_milestone` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","milestoneId":"<saved:milestoneId>"} [A] (no tool reads another user's inbox; this re-reads the announced date)
   IF the call returns an error or result.targetDate != <input:targetDate> → STOP. Say: "The notice was sent, but <saved:mname> shows <result.targetDate>."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:outcome>; notice <saved:notificationId> to <saved:person> (unverified)"; go to Answer.
11. ASK: "Delete milestone <saved:mname> (<saved:milestoneId>)? No undo; activities <saved:holds> keep pointing to it. Closing keeps the history. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was deleted."
12. CALL `delete_milestone` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","milestoneId":"<saved:milestoneId>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not deleted: <error text>. It needs an API key with profile full or custom."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_milestones` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item has id == <saved:milestoneId> → STOP. Say: "Milestone <saved:milestoneId> is still listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:mname> deleted"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: project <input:projectId>, milestone <saved:mname>
Done: <<saved:outcome> | nothing changed>
Evidence: <get_milestone or list_milestones re-read | none>
Pending: <none | open activities: <each of <saved:open> as "<id> '<title>'"> | activities pointing to the deleted milestone: <saved:holds>>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | move open activities with playbook edit-activities | none>
```
Milestone states: open | closed, from your last get_milestone. Never claim a change that a re-read above did not show, or that a notice was read.


## § flow-labels

## Playbook: labels
Use when: create or merge labels

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| action | "create" or "merge"; "rename" when the user asked to rename one | STOP. Say: "Create a label, or merge two?" |
| name | for create: the label name the user gave | "none" |
| color | for create: the user's color as #rrggbb | "#6b7280" |
| keep | for merge: the label to keep (name or id) as the user named it | "none" |
| duplicate | for merge: the label the user called a duplicate (name or id) | "none" |
| projectId | for merge: the one project whose activities to relabel, named by the user | "none" |
| day | today's date as yyyymmdd | — |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. No label was deleted."
1. CALL `list_labels` {} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Labels need an LPM API key (<error text>)."
   Labels are universal: one label is shared by every workspace on the platform. Reuse before creating.
   IF <input:action> == "rename" → STOP. Say: "Renaming a label changes it for every workspace on the platform, so I do not rename labels. Create a new one, or ask an LPM platform admin."
   SAVE: keepId, keepName = the id and name of the item whose id or name equals <input:keep>, ignoring case; dupId, dupName = the same for <input:duplicate>
   IF <input:action> == "merge" → go to step 4.
   IF <input:name> is "none" or an item has the name <input:name>, ignoring case → STOP. Say: "Label <input:name> is missing or already exists (<its id>): I reuse an existing label."
2. ASK: "Create label <input:name> (<input:color>)? Labels are universal: every workspace on the platform will see it. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was created."
3. CALL `create_label` {"name":"<input:name>","color":"<input:color>"} [C] (create once: no retry key)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "create_label failed: <error text>. Run me again: step 1 finds it if it was created."
   SAVE: newId = the id after "ID: " in result
   VERIFY: CALL `list_labels` {} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:newId> and name == <input:name> → STOP. Say: "Label <saved:newId> is not listed as <input:name>."
   SAVE: outcome = "created <input:name> (<saved:newId>)"; go to Answer.
4. IF <saved:keepId> or <saved:dupId> is empty or they are equal → STOP. Say: "Which labels exactly? <each label as "<name> (<id>)">"
   IF <input:projectId> is "none" → STOP. Say: "Which project's activities should I relabel? (one per run)"
   delete_label does not detach the id: relabel first, delete last.
5. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF result.hasMore == true → STOP. Say: "<input:projectId> has more than 100 activities; I cannot check them all. Merge in the LPM web UI."
   SAVE: relabel = the id and labelIds of every item whose labelIds contain <saved:dupId>
   IF <saved:relabel> is empty → go to step 8.
   IF <saved:relabel> has more than 25 items → STOP. Say: "More than 25 activities carry <saved:dupName>; I relabel at most 25. Nothing was changed."
   SAVE: n = 1 + the number of batch keys you already sent in this conversation; key = "relabel-<saved:dupId>-<input:projectId>-<saved:n>"; firstId = the id of the first item of <saved:relabel>
   SAVE: issueId, labelIds = per item of <saved:relabel>: its id, and its labelIds without <saved:dupId> plus <saved:keepId> if absent (labelIds replaces the whole list)
6. CALL `batch_issue_operations` {"idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>","stopOnError":false,"operations":[{"tool":"update_issue","arguments":{"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:issueId>","labelIds":["<saved:labelIds>"]}}]} [A] (one operations item per item of <saved:relabel>; labelIds = that item's full id list)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "batch_issue_operations failed: <error text>. Run me again: step 5 re-reads the activities. No label was deleted."
   SAVE: failed = for each item with status "failed" or "skipped": the issueId of its operation and its error message
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:firstId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or (<saved:firstId> is not in <saved:failed> and result.labelIds contains <saved:dupId>) → STOP. Say: "<saved:firstId> still carries <saved:dupName>. No label was deleted."
   IF <saved:failed> is not empty → STOP. Say: "<each failed as "<issueId> — <error>">. Fix these first; <saved:dupName> was not deleted."
7. FOR EACH item IN <saved:relabel> (none → go to step 8):
   CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<each:id>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.labelIds contains <saved:dupId> or lacks <saved:keepId> → STOP. Say: "<each:id> was not relabeled. <saved:dupName> was not deleted."
8. ASK: "Activities of <input:projectId> now carry <saved:keepName> instead of <saved:dupName>. Delete label <saved:dupName> (<saved:dupId>)? Labels are universal: activities of other projects and workspaces that still carry it keep a dead id. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "<saved:dupName> was kept."
9. CALL `delete_label` {"labelId":"<saved:dupId>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not deleted: <error text>. Deleting a label needs an LPM API key with profile full or custom."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_labels` {} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item has id == <saved:dupId> or no item has id == <saved:keepId> → STOP. Say: "list_labels does not confirm the merge (the delete reports success even for an unknown id)."
   SAVE: outcome = "merged <saved:dupName> into <saved:keepName> on <input:projectId>; <saved:dupName> deleted"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: universal labels (every workspace)<; activities of project <input:projectId> for a merge>
Done: <<saved:outcome> | nothing changed>
Evidence: <list_labels re-read; get_issue read every relabeled activity | none>
Pending: <none | <each failed as "<issueId> — <error>">>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | apply the label with playbook edit-activities | none>
```
Never claim a label was created, deleted or merged unless a re-read above showed it.


## § flow-escalate

## Playbook: escalate
Use when: escalate an activity; notify a person

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| issueId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which activity? (id or title)" |
| reason | "due-date", "stale" or "blocker", from the user's words | STOP. Say: "Is it a due date at risk, a stale activity or a blocker?" |
| cause | the cause in one line, from the user | "unknown" |
| notify | the person the user asked to notify (name or email) | "none" (comment only) |
| day | today's date as yyyymmdd | — |
| now | the current UTC time (ISO 8601) | — |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was written."
1. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: title, dueDate, assigneeId, status, updatedAt = those fields of result (empty if absent)
   IF <saved:status> is "done" or "canceled" → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> is <saved:status>; there is nothing to escalate."
   IF <input:reason> == "due-date" and <saved:dueDate> is empty → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> has no due date. Set one with playbook owners-dates first."
2. CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: last = the createdAt of the newest item (empty if none); since = <saved:last>, else <saved:updatedAt>; key = "<prefix>-<input:issueId>-<input:day>" with prefix "due" for due-date, "stale" for stale, "blocker" for blocker
   IF <input:reason> == "stale" and <saved:since> is less than 48 hours before <input:now> → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> is not stale: last activity <saved:since>."
3. SAVE: text = the template for <input:reason>, filled, in the user's language (translate the labels; delete a line you cannot fill instead of writing "n/a"):
   ```text
   due-date:  Prazo em risco: <saved:title> vence em <saved:dueDate> (em N dias) | venceu em <saved:dueDate> (N dias de atraso).
              Responsável: <saved:assigneeId>, ou "sem responsável"
              Causa: <input:cause>
              Pedido: confirmar nova data ou reduzir o escopo até <date>.
   stale:     Sem atualização há <hours> h (desde <saved:since>).
              Risco: <what slips if it stays stopped>
              Pergunta para <saved:assigneeId>: bloqueio, decisão pendente ou mudança de escopo?
   blocker:   Bloqueio: <input:cause> — desbloqueia: <who> — desde <date>
              Próximo passo: <action>, por <who>
   ```
4. CALL `create_comment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","content":"<saved:text>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>"} [A] (a second escalation on the same day returns the first comment; the SAVE below reports it)
   SAVE: commentId = the id after "ID: " in result
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:commentId> is missing → STOP. Say: "Comment <saved:commentId> is not listed on <input:issueId>."
   SAVE: shown = "yes" if item <saved:commentId> has the text you sent, else "no (an earlier escalation with key <saved:key> already exists)"
   IF <input:notify> is "none" → go to Answer.
5. CALL `list_project_assignable_members` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Notifications need an LPM API key (profile full or custom): <error text>. The comment was posted."
   SAVE: matches = the items whose displayName or email contains <input:notify>, ignoring case
   IF <saved:matches> is empty or has 2 or more items → STOP. Say: "Which person: <each match as "<displayName> (<email>)">?"
   Show only displayName and email; never hourlyRate or currency; never pick one yourself. Take the uid only from this list: the server accepts any userId.
   SAVE: uid = the uid of the one match; person = its displayName (else its email); type = "due-date" for due-date, else "action_required"; message = the first line of <saved:text>
6. ASK: "Notify <saved:person> (<saved:uid>): "<saved:title>" — <saved:message>, type <saved:type>? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "No notification was sent; the comment stays."
7. CALL `create_notification` {"userId":"<saved:uid>","title":"<saved:title>","message":"<saved:message>","type":"<saved:type>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Notification not sent: <error text>. I do not retry it."
   SAVE: notificationId = the id after "ID: " in result
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A] (no tool reads another user's inbox; this re-reads the escalation the notice points to)
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:commentId> is missing → STOP. Say: "The notice was sent, but comment <saved:commentId> is gone."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: project <input:projectId>, activity <input:issueId> <saved:title>
Done: comment <saved:commentId> (key <saved:key>, new text shown: <saved:shown>); <notification <saved:notificationId> to <saved:person> (delivery unverified) | no notification>; status <saved:status>
Evidence: <list_comments listed <saved:commentId> | none>
Pending: <none | a new due date or owner needs playbook owners-dates and the user's approval>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none>
```
status: backlog | todo | in-progress | done | canceled, from step 1. Never claim a comment that the VERIFY did not list, and never claim a notice was read.
